headline: Global Education announces public plan for share buyback
hook: Share buyback proposed by Global Education
summary: Global Education Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a public announcement for a share buyback. Share buybacks typically reduce the total number of shares in circulation, which can improve key financial metrics such as earnings per share. Retail investors holding the stock should review the upcoming record date and pricing details once released by the company. Such corporate actions are relevant for evaluating capital allocation strategies and potential impact on shareholder value.
whats_next: Detailed buyback record date and pricing announcement
why_it_matters: Potential value unlocking for existing shareholders through reduced share supply
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / company cash reserves reduced

headline: Global Education fixes November 18, 2026 as record date for buy-back
hook: Record date set for upcoming share buyback
summary: Global Education Limited has announced that Wednesday, November 18, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming share buyback. Eligible shareholders holding shares as of this date will participate in the buyback process. This corporate action determines who is entitled to tender their shares to the company. Retail investors holding the stock need to ensure their shares are credited before the record date.
whats_next: November 18, 2026 record date for the buy-back
why_it_matters: Determines shareholder eligibility for the upcoming share buyback.

headline: Global Education sets record date for share buyback
hook: Buyback record date set for November
summary: Global Education Limited has informed the stock exchange that the record date for its upcoming share buyback will be November 18, 2026. Shareholders holding shares as of this date will be eligible to participate in the buyback process. This corporate action provides an opportunity for existing investors to tender their shares. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note this date to ensure eligibility.
why_it_matters: Hold shares by November 18 to participate in buyback

headline: Global Education submits postal ballot voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Postal ballot results finalized at Global Education
summary: Global Education Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the proceedings and voting results of its recent postal ballot. The company also submitted a copy of the scrutinizer's report detailing the shareholding votes. This is routine corporate governance filing for listed entities. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update has no material financial impact on the company's stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate filing with no direct impact on stock valuation.

headline: Global Education issues corrigendum for postal ballot notice on buyback
hook: Changes issued for postal ballot notice
summary: Global Education Limited has issued a corrigendum to its postal ballot notice dated September 24, 2026. The notice previously detailed a proposed buy-back of equity shares via the tender offer route. Retail shareholders holding the stock should review the corrected terms for the upcoming corporate action.
whats_next: Postal ballot voting on buyback proposal
why_it_matters: Review corrected buyback terms before the postal ballot.
